description: T1-19. Lets the daemon-served UI at http://127.0.0.1:4747 call check_for_updates_command, and nothing else, from nowhere else. The main window loads WebviewUrl::External(DAEMON_URL), so Tauri treats it as a REMOTE origin (is_local_url, tauri-2.11.5/src/webview/mod.rs:1698) and rejects every custom command from it unless a remote capability names one (webview/mod.rs:1823). This is that capability, deliberately kept to the single command whose worst case is an attacker who already controls the page learning which Clockwork version is out. `local` is false on purpose: the only local page this shell ever loads is daemon-down.html, which invokes nothing, so granting it IPC would widen the grant for no caller. No core:default, and no second permission.
